draw_constitution.important: No seed, eligible pool or winner may be chosen after observing a preferred result. Published narrative must distinguish constructed historical draw from sourced ESPN bracket.
draw_constitution.eligibility_law: Stable lexicon ID order, physical venue and round, minimum technology year, no severe-event conditions. One per fixture, all three stages directly executed by principal.
draw_constitution.avoid_repeating_seed: Consecutive allocated historical matches within the same season and round should prefer unique selections via a predeclared no-repeat ordering; if no options remain the draw may reuse.
draw_constitution.winner_policy: The draw chooses WHAT is attempted, never WHO wins. Official ESPN source remains independently immutable.
draw_constitution.future_2026_policy: DO NOT DRAW A NAMED 2026 MATCHUP UNTIL OFFICIAL PAIRING IS LOCKED; a source-specific future-season seed can be published before outcome, but not in advance of opponents.
